claims.text: The assessment does not estimate government infrastructure repair costs. Its model scope is the difference in government revenue without versus with the modeled ENSO event, transmitted through agriculture and fiscal models, so no infrastructure damage or repair-cost quantity is produced for Viet Nam or any other country.
Viet Nam mean conditional government revenue loss for the first projection year (signed mean; gains retained)
Viet Nam probability of a government revenue loss for the first projection year
Viet Nam expected shortfall at the ninety-five percent level (positive-part tail shortfall) for the first projection year
Viet Nam mean conditional government revenue loss for the second projection year (signed mean; gains retained)
Viet Nam probability of a government revenue loss for the second projection year
Viet Nam expected shortfall at the ninety-five percent level (positive-part tail shortfall) for the second projection year

These figures quantify the modelled shortfall in government revenue, which reduces the fiscal resources a government might have available for discretionary spending, but they are not measures of infrastructure repair costs and cannot be reinterpreted as such.

limitations: The assessment contains no estimate of Vietnam government infrastructure repair costs; the question cannot be answered with the provided evidence.
Model scope covers agriculture, forestry and fishing value added and conditional government revenue transmission only; physical damage, reconstruction or repair expenditure is outside scope.
Estimates are conditional scenario differences (neutral versus event revenue) on a stated macroeconomic path, not causal attribution of observed outcomes.
Historical input provenance is incomplete and the assessment is marked as inspection-only and not recomputable.
Signed mean losses can be positive or negative, while the tail expected-shortfall figures are positive-part shortfalls; the two are not interchangeable.
Results are expressed in constant 2025 USD with a fixed 2025 exchange rate, so they are not directly comparable to nominal repair budgets.
No two-year joint Viet Nam figure is available in the provided evidence packet; year-specific figures only are reported and country quantiles were not summed.
